# STRUCTURE.md — Directory Layout & Organization
<!-- Generated by gsd-map-codebase sequential mapping -->

## Top-Level Layout

```
7/                                    ← Project root (version 0.5, build 7)
├── 34970A_5.py                       ← Main sensor logger (acquisition subsystem)
├── VarAmbseries0.6.2.py              ← Historical analysis GUI (standalone)
├── runMain.bat                       ← Master launcher (opens 3 cmd windows)
├── runVarAmb.bat                     ← Launcher for 34970A_5.py
├── runVarAmb2.bat                    ← Launcher for Bokeh server
├── runVarAmbSeries.bat               ← Launcher for VarAmbseries0.6.2.py
├── README.txt                        ← Project readme (UTF-16LE encoded, Portuguese)
├── streamingLab/                     ← Bokeh real-time dashboard app package
│   ├── __init__.py                   ← Empty (marks as Bokeh app package)
│   ├── main.py                       ← Bokeh app entry point
│   ├── SensorV2.py                   ← Sensor reader thread + GUM uncertainty
│   ├── Visual.py                     ← Bokeh real-time plots + controls
│   ├── Visual_with_stats.py          ← Tabbed layout: real-time + hourly stats
│   ├── TestcodeLogging34970A_v2.py   ← XML reader (current version used by SensorV2)
│   ├── Logging34970A.py              ← XML reader (legacy version)
│   └── Configura_34970A-140824...    ← Configuration notes/doc (partial name)
└── AmbSeries/                        ← Duplicate/backup of VarAmbseries
    ├── VarAmbseries0.6.2.py          ← Mirror of top-level script
    └── runVarAmbSeries.bat           ← Mirror of top-level bat
```

## Generated Data Layout (runtime)

```
./varamblog/                          ← Created by 34970A_5.py at runtime
└── {YYDDD}/                         ← e.g., 26100 = year 2026, day 100
    └── log_ambientvars-{YYDDD}.xml  ← Daily XML log file
```

## Naming Conventions

| Convention | Pattern | Example |
|------------|---------|---------|
| Version directories | `{major}/{minor}` | `0.5/7` |
| Daily log dirs | `{YY}{DDD}` | `26100` |
| Daily log files | `log_ambientvars-{YYDDD}.xml` | `log_ambientvars-26100.xml` |
| Sensor tags (XML) | `{RH\|TC}{letter}` | `RHA`, `TCB` |
| Script versions | `{name}{version}.py` | `VarAmbseries0.6.2.py` |

## Key Locations

| What | Where |
|------|-------|
| Sensor acquisition loop | `34970A_5.py` — `while True:` block |
| GPIB configuration commands | `34970A_5.py` — `cfg = deque([...])` |
| Calibration math | `34970A_5.py` — `sym.solve(...)` |
| Channel-property mapping | `34970A_5.py` — `dictprop = {...}` |
| GUM uncertainty constants | `streamingLab/SensorV2.py` — top-level constants block |
| Latest XML reader | `streamingLab/TestcodeLogging34970A_v2.py` — `Datalog.list_file()` |
| Bokeh real-time plot | `streamingLab/Visual.py` — `Visual.definePlot()` |
| Bokeh stats plot | `streamingLab/Visual_with_stats.py` — `VisualStats.update_stats()` |
| Historical GUI main | `VarAmbseries0.6.2.py` — `main()` + `on_process()` |

## Duplication / Redundancy

| File | Duplicate of | Notes |
|------|-------------|-------|
| `AmbSeries/VarAmbseries0.6.2.py` | Top-level `VarAmbseries0.6.2.py` | Likely copy-paste; may diverge |
| `AmbSeries/runVarAmbSeries.bat` | Top-level `runVarAmbSeries.bat` | Same content |
| `streamingLab/Logging34970A.py` | `streamingLab/TestcodeLogging34970A_v2.py` | `v2` is current; original is legacy |

## What's Missing

- No `requirements.txt` / `environment.yml`
- No `.gitignore`
- No unit tests directory
- No `__version__` or `setup.py`
- No `.env` or config file
- No `varamblog/` in repo (created at runtime — also not gitignored)
